output.review_comment: The PR introduces bulk/bracket pricing logic (lines 31-34) solely to make test_bulk_order pass, but this directly contradicts the docstring which specifies graduated pricing ("every unit is charged at the price of the tier that its own position falls in"). While the negative value check and off-by-one fix are correct, the special case for the open-ended tier needs to be either: (1) documented in the docstring to explain this behavior, or (2) discussed with the team about whether the spec actually requires this bracket pricing behavior. The current code silently implements undocumented behavior that contradicts the existing documentation.
